summary: Iteration 84: Tested devices page refactoring and WeighingFlow functionality for beneficiary role. Fixed a bug where handleScaleWeighing was undefined. All features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All devices page features working. WeighingFlow opens correctly with 4 instructions, video countdown, and results. Refactoring verified - devices.tsx is 49 lines (thin router). Bug fixed: handleScaleWeighing → openWeighingFlow in DeviceDetailPopup callback.

devices_page_loads.description: Devices page loads without errors for beneficiary role

balance_vita_nouvelle_pesee_only.description: Balance Vita card shows only 'Nouvelle pesée' button, no separate 'Pesées' history button

weighing_flow_opens.description: Clicking 'Nouvelle pesée' on scale card opens WeighingFlow popup with instructions

weighing_flow_step1_instructions.description: Step 1 shows 4 instruction steps: sol plat, pieds nus, immobile, and 'Je suis prêt' button

weighing_flow_video_countdown.description: Clicking 'Je suis prêt' opens 15-second video countdown with DNA video background

weighing_countdown_timer.description: Video countdown shows timer ring and countdown from 15 to 0 (verified decreasing)

weighing_results.description: After 15 seconds, results page shows weight (kg) and body composition (Graisse, Muscle, Hydratation, Metabolisme)

weighing_flow_close_button.description: Close (X) button on WeighingFlow works correctly

bracelet_elio_buttons.description: Bracelet Elio card shows 'Associer' and 'Decouvrir' buttons

gilet_elder_en_veille_badge.description: Gilet Elder card shows 'En veille' orange badge

device_detail_popup.description: Device detail popup opens when clicking device info button, shows weighing history and 'Nouvelle pesée' button

guardian_role_prescription_management.description: Devices page works for guardian role - PrescriptionManagement component loads with prescription UI

bottom_navigation_tabs.description: Bottom navigation tabs work correctly, home tab navigates to dashboard

refactoring_verification.description: devices.tsx is now 49 lines (thin router). All components extracted to /components/devices/

bug_fixed.impact: Device detail popup 'Nouvelle pesée' button now correctly opens WeighingFlow
